curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As unexpected suitors enter the fold, will their tightly bound household adapt to the changes or quietly unravel?
curatedMovie.description: In Taipei, retired master chef Chu shares a home with his three unmarried adult daughters. As each woman begins a new romance, shifting expectations begin to upend their long-standing domestic life.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Patient, thoughtful, and emotionally grounded, offering a warm domestic mix of gentle humor and relationship drama.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Ang Lee balances warm comedy and gentle domestic drama, exploring family ties and tradition through rich meals and quietly shifting generational romance.
